chunks.text: Been thinking about a little trip around Beijing, and I might just get a car while I'm there so I’m not juggling taxis the whole time.
And separately, I’ve also been toying with the idea of catching a movie in Chongqing—just trying to picture how that day would even work out.
If I end up doing the Beijing part, I keep coming back to a Buick GL8, picking it up on 2026-03-22, and maybe keeping it for 5 days.
For that car thing, it’d probably be under the name He Xia—though I’m still not totally committed to the whole plan.
On the Chongqing movie side, I was leaning toward Kung Fu Panda 4 at Wanda Cinema Jiefangbei, the 11:30 show, two seats, and the name would be Lin Bo… not sure if I’ll actually do this, we’ll see.
